caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with three horizontal, oval-shaped slats across the backrest. The wood is brown with visible grain texture and shading, showing cylindrical legs and supports. The seat is a woven material, rendered in grayish tones, constructed in a crisscross pattern. Four legs support the chair, each rounded and slightly tapered at the bottom. The legs are connected by horizontal crossbars on each side, matching the color and texture of the rest of the chair. The drawing is centered on a plain, off-white background and framed within a faintly outlined rectangular border. No other objects or colors are present in the composition.
title: Wooden Chair
